steps.title: Tag the animals sold
steps.detail: Scan or type the tag of every animal on this sale, enter its weight, and confirm. This step completes on its own once the tagging is confirmed.

steps.title: Record the animals being loaded
steps.detail: One live video of the tagged animals walking onto the buyer's vehicle, ear tags visible.

steps.title: Photo of the gate pass
steps.detail: One photo of the signed gate pass or dispatch note handed to the buyer's driver.

steps.title: Has the buyer paid in full?
steps.detail: Answer Yes when the receipts on the sale cover its value. Answer No if a balance is still due.

steps.title: Collect the balance and record the receipt
steps.detail: Follow up with the buyer for the amount still due and record each receipt on the sale as it comes in.
